title: 第17章 姐妹两个第18章 收拾败类
content_zh:
;;
科莫多的眼神早就定在了唐诗逸身上了。
美到极致的身材和脸蛋儿。
他的大手一把捏在唐诗逸的腰间。
唐诗逸一下子扑进他的怀里。
陈楚一怔。
唐诗逸这是什么意思？
这就是仙女配怪兽啊。
突如其来的投怀送抱，让科多兴奋地不能自已。
一边脱衣服，一边指着身边的保镖。
“你们还愣着干什么？赶快出去啊？”
“大哥，我们是保护您安全的啊？”
“放屁！”
科莫多大声骂道：“老子和美女办事，也用你保证安全？你们是不是想偷看？赶紧给我滚！”
十几个保镖没办法。
“大哥，我们在门口……”
这时候，唐诗逸也狠狠瞪了一眼陈楚。
“你也给我滚出去！”
“我也滚？”陈楚指着自己鼻子。
“没错！”

唐诗逸面色阴冷：“我和科多办事，不喜欢任何人看到。”
科多高兴的脸上的黑肉直颤悠。
“表弟啊，麻烦你也先出去吧，等我和你表姐办完事，舒服了再喊你！”
唐诗逸继续阴冷起来。
“你是聋子还是瞎子？乡巴佬还不快滚？”
“好吧。”
陈楚起身，走出门，不过他的欢喜鏖战功法可以透视。
展开透视功能，穿过铁门，发现里面的唐诗逸刚脱了外套，然后就绕到了科多身后。
忽然，她抽出一条极细的钢丝，飞快的绕住科多的脖子。
用力拉扯。
“咕噜……”
科多正在脱裤子，被这突如其来的攻击弄的手忙脚乱。
想要发声喊叫，但喉咙被钢丝勒住，根本叫不出声。
不过科多太强壮了。
五百多斤的胖子，用力扭动身体。
窈窕的唐诗逸便被甩开。
科多摸了摸肥胖的脖子。
被钢丝勒出血迹。
“妈的，臭表子！敢和我玩这一套！我现在就玩了你，然后让兄弟们一起干你！”

Komodo's eyes have long been fixed on Tang Shiyi.
Extremely beautiful body and face.
His big hands pinched Tang Shiyi's waist.
Tang Shiyi suddenly threw herself into his arms.
Chen Chu was startled.
Tang Shiyi What does this mean?
This is a fairy and a monster.
The sudden embrace made Kodo so excited that he couldn't help himself.
While taking off his clothes, he pointed at the bodyguard beside him.
"What are you still doing? Come out quickly?"
"Brother, are we protecting your safety?"
"Fart!"
Komodo cursed loudly: "I am working with a beautiful woman, and I need you to ensure safety? Do you want to take a peek? Get out of here!"
There's nothing a dozen bodyguards can do.
"Brother, we are at the door..."
At this time, Tang Shiyi also glared at Chen Chu fiercely.
"Get out of here too!"
"Should I get out too?" Chen Chu pointed at his nose.
"That's right!"
Tang Shiyi's expression was grim: "Keduo and I are doing things, and I don't want anyone to see us."
The dark flesh on Kodo's happy face trembled.
"Cousin, please go out first. I'll call you when your cousin and I finish our work and feel comfortable!"
Tang Shiyi continued to feel cold.
"Are you deaf or blind? Why don't you country bumpkin get out of here?"
"Okay."
Chen Chu stood up and walked out of the door, but his joyful fighting skills could be seen through.
Expand the perspective function, pass through the iron gate, and find that Tang Shiyi inside has just taken off his coat, and then walked around behind Kodo.
Suddenly, she pulled out a very thin wire and quickly wrapped it around Kodo's neck.
Pull hard.
"Gulu..."
Kodo was taking off his pants and was confused by the sudden attack.
He wanted to scream, but his throat was strangled by the wire and he couldn't scream at all.
But Kodo is too strong.
The fat man, who weighed more than 500 pounds, twisted his body vigorously.
The slim Tang Shiyi was thrown away.
Kodo touched the fat neck.
Bleeding from being strangled with a wire.
"Damn, you stinky cousin! How dare you play this trick with me! I will play with you now, and then let the brothers fuck you together!"
